name: community_key
description: Canonical community key: upper-case, punctuation stripped, aliases.csv folded. The hub builder groups on it

name: community_distance_km
description: km from the point to its labelled community's city/CDP boundary (0-ish = inside; blank = untested). Hub builder remote_site_km reads it

name: located_in_place
description: The city/CDP polygon(s) the point physically sits in, as the boundary file names it; blank = none. The label (community_name) is the service community and is never changed

name: community_relation
description: inside | adjacent (neighbouring place <= boundary_review_km, same town) | remote (no boundary) | elsewhere (another community's boundary > review km) | untested

name: corrections_applied
description: ;-joined fields an approved correction changed on this record

name: qc_release
description: Release label the table was published from

name: qc_status
description: clean | pending_review (the record has an open item in review_queue.csv). The build withholds pending_review records from hub aggregation when the profile's hubs.withhold_pending_review is on

name: facility_id
description: Stable facility id both repositories key on: the AEA ast_facility_id where the release carries one, else a synthetic id minted once and recorded in inputs/inventory_qc/facility_ids.csv (append-only ledger; the harness's element registry fingerprints it with the coordinates, so it never moves). Blank = not located

name: aea_region
description: AEA energy region (Alaska_Energy_Authority_Library, 11 regions) the point sits in; the nearest region within thresholds aea_region_nearest_km when it sits in none; blank beyond that or when not located. The harness's located_in / regions tables read it

name: aea_region_relation
description: inside | nearest (in no region polygon; assigned the nearest within aea_region_nearest_km) | outside (farther than that; region blank) | untested (not located)

name: aea_region_distance_km
description: 0 when inside; km from the point to the nearest region polygon when it sits in none; blank = untested
